integrity: General theorem proved from explicit finite-dimensional inequalities; exhaustive small prime-field computations provide corroboration only. Published classification and counting facts are cited as prerequisites, not new discoveries.
scientific_limitations: Counts only simple evolution algebras, not all non-perfect algebras
Asymptotics require fixed finite field size q >=3 as n grows
Generic triviality is conditional on uniformly labeled simple matrices, not uniform on isomorphism classes
No optimized sharp exponential error exponent is asserted
Historical priority and independent verification are not certified
title: Asymptotic rigid-simple orbit law for finite-field evolution algebras
